dt-example.title: Predefined states
dt-example.info:
This example shows how predefined states can be supplied using the StateRestore extension and its `-init stateRestore.preDefined` option. With this you can create a set of useful states that are immediately accessible to the end user.
In this case, the states present under the _Saved states_ button provide saved states for a filter, order and the two combined. The end user still has the ability to create their own states and can use the predefined states as the basis for their own.
